revised: 15.3   Data Security. In the event of any actual or reasonably suspected unauthorized access, use, disclosure, modification, or destruction of research data (a "Security Incident"), the affected Party shall: (a) provide preliminary written notice to the other Party within seventy-two (72) hours after discovering the Security Incident, with sufficient detail for the other Party to assess its own regulatory exposure, including the known nature and scope of the incident, the categories of data affected, and known containment measures; (b) provide a full written disclosure within seven (7) days after forensic confirmation, supplemented as additional material facts become known; (c) if the affected Party is Party B and the Security Incident requires physical investigation of closed-network hardware, use an extended preliminary notice window only to the extent reasonably necessary to complete that investigation, provided that Party B identifies a point of contact and an estimated timeline within the seventy-two (72) hour standard window; and (d) disclose within seventy-two (72) hours after discovery any unlogged access event identified after the fact, including the date discovered, the affected systems or data, and the known or reasonably suspected scope of access. Each Party shall cooperate in investigating and remedying the Security Incident.

original: Section 1.  Termination for Casualty.  If the Leased Premises are damaged or destroyed by fire or other casualty, Base Rent and Additional Rent shall abate in full of the date of such damage until the Leased Premises are restored and Tenant is able to resume normal production operations. Landlord shall, within thirty (30) days after the casualty, deliver to Tenant Landlord’s good-faith estimate of the time required to complete restoration. Tenant may terminate this Lease by written notice given at any time before substantial completion if (a) Landlord’s restoration estimate exceeds ninety (90) days from the date of casualty, (b) the cost to restore exceeds ten percent (10%) of the replacement cost of the Leased Premises, (c) restoration is not substantially completed within thirty (30) days after the estimated completion date, or (d) the casualty occurs during the final twenty-four (24) months of the then-current Term. Upon any such termination, any unearned rent paid in advance shall be refunded and the Security Deposit returned in full. Landlord shall have no right to terminate this Lease by reason of casualty.
revised: Section 1.  Termination for Casualty.  If the Leased Premises are damaged or destroyed by fire or other casualty, Base Rent and Additional Rent shall abate only in proportion to the portion of the Leased Premises rendered unusable for the Permitted Use, and only for the period of that unusability. Landlord shall, within thirty (30) days after the casualty, deliver to Tenant Landlord’s good-faith estimate of the time required to complete restoration. Tenant may terminate this Lease by written notice before substantial completion if (a) Landlord’s restoration estimate exceeds two hundred seventy (270) days from the date of casualty or (b) restoration is not substantially completed within ninety (90) days after the estimated completion date. Upon any such termination, any unearned rent paid in advance shall be refunded and the Security Deposit returned subject to Section 3 of Article V. Landlord may terminate this Lease if the damage exceeds twenty-five percent (25%) of the building’s replacement cost, the casualty occurs during the final twenty-four (24) months of the Term, or the damage is materially uninsured.

The term of this Lease is ten (10) years, commencing on the Commencement Date and expiring at 11:59 p.m. on the last day of the one hundred twentieth (120th) full calendar month thereafter (the "Term"). The "Commencement Date" is the earlier of (i) the date Landlord delivers the Premises to Tenant with Landlord's Work substantially complete, or (ii) the date Tenant takes full occupancy of the entire Premises for the commencement of its business operations.  The parties agree that Tenant shall be permitted to work alongside Landlord as Landlord performs its Work, and Tenant’s entry upon the Premises for the purposes of planning, preparing plans, infrastructure construction, obtaining permits and approvals, equipment and furnishing installations, etc., shall not trigger the Commencement Date or require any rental payments during such time. The estimated Commencement Date is March 1, 2027.

original: 1.15 "Indemnity Claim" has the meaning given in Section 12.6.
revised: 1.15 "Indemnity Claim" means any third-party claim for which indemnification is sought under Section 12.4 or Section 12.5.
